# stapel-promotions 0.1.0

Promo codes and automatic discounts for a Stapel shop. Staff define promotions (percent off, a fixed amount off, or free shipping), scoped to the whole cart, one purchasable type or a list of purchasable keys, with a time window, a minimum subtotal, a stackable flag and usage caps in total and per shopper; codes are many per promotion, case-insensitive, single-use or shared, optionally bound to one shopper, and generated in bulk. Automatic promotions apply without a code. The brick plugs into stapel-orders by Function name only: promotions.quote is the discount adjuster (deterministic, no writes, one adjustment per promotion, free shipping as a marker the shipping adjuster honours) and promotions.reserve/commit/release is the checkout hook that ledgers each use under the promotion's row lock, so two shoppers racing for the last use end as one order and one promo_code_exhausted. Money is Decimal end to end; a discount never exceeds what it applies to.

Contract: axes 1 · extension points 7 · operations 14 · error codes 65 · flows 2.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- RETURN_USAGE_ON_RELEASE [bool, default true] — Cancelled orders give the code back
  true (default): when an order that used a promo code is cancelled, the use is returned, so a single-use code works again. false: the use stays spent. Values: true, false.

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_PROMOTION_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_PUBLIC_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_CODE_PRESENTER / STAPEL_PROMOTIONS_REDEMPTION_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the staff, public, code and ledger presenters.
- promotions.codes.issue [comm_function]
  Mint new unique codes of a promotion, optionally bound to one user and single-use — the reward strategy a referral program calls.
- promotions.promotion.exhausted [comm_event]
  A promotion reached its total usage cap.
- promotions.quote [comm_function]
  The orders adjuster (kind discount, order 100). Reads context.codes; answers one negative adjustment per applied promotion and promo_code_* errors that refuse the checkout until the shopper removes the code.
- promotions.redemption.committed [comm_event]
  A use became permanent (the order was placed): promotion, code, user, order, amount.
- promotions.redemption.released [comm_event]
  A committed use was given back (a cancelled order), with the reason.
- promotions.reserve / promotions.commit / promotions.release [comm_function]
  The orders checkout hook. Reserve ledgers the promotions the order snapshot grants under the promotion row lock (re-counting caps), commit makes them permanent, release gives them back; all idempotent on the checkout attempt key.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-auth (optional) — per-shopper caps are keyed on the user id; user.merged moves a guest's uses to the account on sign-in
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (promotions.* Functions and facts, user.merged consumer), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
- stapel-orders (optional) — calls promotions.quote as its discount adjuster and promotions.reserve/commit/release as a checkout hook once stapel_promotions.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS is in STAPEL_ORDERS; without orders the staff API, validate endpoint and Functions still work

## HTTP operations (14) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/promotions/api/v1/`.
### Promotions
- GET /active/ — promotions_active_list
- POST /codes/validate/ — promotions_codes_validate
- DELETE /staff/codes/{code_id}/ — promotions_staff_code_destroy
- PATCH /staff/codes/{code_id}/ — promotions_staff_code_update
- POST /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/codes/ — promotions_staff_codes_create
- GET /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/codes/export/ — promotions_staff_codes_export
- POST /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/codes/generate/ — promotions_staff_codes_generate
- GET /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/codes/ — promotions_staff_codes_list
- POST /staff/promotions/ — promotions_staff_promotions_create
- DELETE /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/ — promotions_staff_promotions_destroy
- GET /staff/promotions/ — promotions_staff_promotions_list
- GET /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/ — promotions_staff_promotions_retrieve
- PATCH /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/ — promotions_staff_promotions_update
- GET /staff/promotions/{promotion_id}/redemptions/ — promotions_staff_redemptions_list
